ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-3,
Neighborhood Commercial District, symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-L in
the area bound by:

West Ainslie Street, North Avondale Avenue; a line 50 feet southwest of and parallel to
West Ainslie Street; and, North Lipps Avenue

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

_——

Patrick Murphey
Zoning Administrator

Common Address:
4835-41 North Lipps Avenue
